text:
noah: Heads-up: finalizing handbook language for mandatory managers onboarding training. Draft here: https://docs.internal/redwood/hr/manager-onboarding-train-draft
maya: Quick Q  does this replace the old 30-day checklist or sit alongside it?
li: It replaces the checklist for managers only; IC onboarding checklist stays the same. Updated FAQ included in the doc.
noah: Good. We also need payroll to confirm whether paid training hours count as overtime for hourly leads. @payroll
payroll: Looking now. Preliminary: paid training counts as paid hours; overtime only if weekly hours exceed threshold. Will confirm by EOD.
ops-admin: Scheduling note: two live manager sessions next week (Wed 10am PT, Fri 2pm PT). Ops will auto-enroll managers who haven't completed by 48h before each session.
maya: Can we add an accommodation flow for managers on leave? e.g., extend window to 30 days post-return.
li: Yes, adding an accommodations clause and a contact point: hr-accommodations@redwood.internal.
hr-bot: 1767002360: Training assignment created and CSV upload scheduled to s3://redwood-compliance/manager_onboard/assignments-1767002360.csv
noah: We'll require a short quiz (70% pass) and transcript evidence for compliance audits. Please ensure captions and transcript for the video.
ops-admin: Noted. We'll include captions and a downloadable transcript. Also adding reminders at 72h and 7 days after assignment.
payroll: Confirmed: no additional retro pay if training occurs within the assignment window. I'll post official note in the doc when finalized.
maya: I'll draft a 2-paragraph manager announcement and post here for sign-off.
li: Can someone own the compliance tracker update? We need manager completion exported weekly to People Ops sheet.
noah: @ops-admin you own the tracker sync. Ops-admin: yes, weekly exports to https://sheets.internal/redwood/peopleops-training-tracker.
hr-bot: 1767002385: Manager completion CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/manager_onboard/completions-1767002385.csv
noah: Action items: Maya  announcement draft; Li  handbook wording & accommodations; Payroll  final confirmation; Ops-admin  enrollments, reminders, tracker. Will publish after payroll note. :thumbsup:
